bz.rng: one default_rng(20261015) for all tasks/metrics; pairs sorted by pair ID

bp.rng: analyze initializes one default_rng(20261015) per invocation/model; no reset across temperatures/subsets. Labels insertion follows supplied runs then file lines.

scope: Explicit canonical reproduction ordering from source and original command shards, not a fabricated original analyze invocation. Original permutation p-values may depend on missing invocation order; retain exact differences.
ad_hoc_adjustment: Exact inline code/invocation not found in scoped original source/current tools/top-level scratch metadata; source log gives only acc~chaotic+generation entropy+task+greedy and rounded results. Cannot claim exact historical adjusted-estimator replay.
